verdict.rationale: Vue 3 does offer a built-in reactivity API (reactive/ref) that can be composed into simple global stores without Vuex/Pinia, but the evidence pack never mentions this pattern; it only shows community praise for Vue's 'official' store solution Vuex (vue-comm-9, vue-comm-13), which is itself a separate library rather than a built-in primitive. Missing for 10: explicit docs or examples showing reactive()/ref() used for cross-component global state, and any confirmation this is a documented recommended pattern instead of always reaching for Pinia/Vuex.
